segments.text: Teotihuacan was a city in the Basin of Mexico, about 225 miles northwest of Monte Albán, near what is now Mexico City.
segments.text_markdown: Teotihuacan var en by i Mexicodalen, omtrent 225 miles nordvest for Monte Albán, nær det som nå er Mexico by.

segments.text: At its peak, it may have housed 100,000 to 200,000 people, making it one of the largest cities on Earth at the time.

segments.text: Its enormous pyramids — the Pyramid of the Sun and the Pyramid of the Moon — still stand today, and they are among the most visited archaeological sites in the Americas.
